description: Code Engine applications (always-on or scale-to-zero HTTP services). Identify an app with project_id and app_name. After create or update, call again with action wait_ready. For logs, events, instances, and revisions use ce_app_inspect. Call get_schema with name ce_app for every action's fields.

action.description: list: List apps in the project. | get: Get one app, including status and endpoint URL. Needs app_name. | create: Create an app from a container image. Needs app_name, image. | update: Change image, scaling, command, or arguments. Creates a new revision. Needs app_name. | wait_ready: Poll until the app is ready or timeout_seconds passes. Needs app_name. | restart: Restart running instances so they pick up the latest config. Needs app_name. | rollback: Re-apply an earlier revision. Find revision_name with ce_app_inspect action revisions. Needs app_name, revision_name. | sync_env: Apply a local .env file to the app (target=app) or to a generic secret (target=secret). | find_idle: List apps that never scale to zero (scale_min_instances > 0) and so cost money when idle. | delete: Delete an app. Needs app_name.

app_name.description: Application name, from ce_app action list.

dotenv_path.description: Path to the .env file (default: .env in the current working directory)

image_secret.description: Registry secret name for pulling the image (e.g. icr-pull-secret)

include_revisions.description: Also count revisions per app (extra API calls). Default false.

project_id.description: Project id or name, from ce_project action list.

replace.description: When target=app, replace all env vars instead of merging (default: false = merge)

revision_name.description: The revision to roll back to (from ce_app_inspect with action revisions)

run_args.description: Arguments passed to the container entrypoint (run_arguments). Required for supergateway: ["--stdio", "npx -y <mcp-server>", "--outputTransport", "sse"]

run_commands.description: Override the container entrypoint (run_commands). Rarely needed — use run_args for passing flags.

target.description: Apply as app env vars or create/replace a generic secret (default: app)

name: ce_app
